findings.severity: app-side prototype limitation (recorded, not fixed: non-trivial CSRF-recovery surface, out of task-20 scope)
findings.finding: A full page reload (F5/deep link) resets the web client's in-memory CSRF token (client.ts module state); the next unsafe action then fails 403 csrf_rejected until the next login. The app's own in-app links navigate client-side, so citation/viewer journeys never hit it.
findings.observed_in: first E2E attempt used page.goto() for notebook navigation -> paste 403 csrf_rejected; reproduced with a focused browser probe (scratch/t20-gate/debug-paste.mjs)
findings.workaround: E2E navigates SPA-style (pushState + popstate), matching real user flows

grounding_change_in_bundle.change: resolve-locator now joins canonical_locators + contract JSON so the payload carries locator_kind/media_type/page/char_start/char_end
grounding_change_in_bundle.why_needed: the source viewer needs media_type + page to seek PDF locators; the E2E PDF leg asserts media_type=application/pdf and page=1 — this change is exercised by the gate evidence
grounding_change_in_bundle.gates: ruff/mypy/import-linter/pytest 128 all green with the change included
